# cursor Provider

Manage Cursor Automations and Origin repository rulesets, and read Origin repositories. Automations use the Cursor Automations API over Connect RPC. Origin calls use the public Origin API and the same auth token.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    cursor = {
      source  = "cursor/cursor"
      version = "~> 0.1"
    }
  }
}

provider "cursor" {
  # Or set the CURSOR_TOKEN environment variable.
  token = var.cursor_token
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `endpoint` (String) Cursor API base URL. Defaults to https://api2.cursor.sh. Can also be set via CURSOR_ENDPOINT.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Auth token for the Cursor API. Can also be set via CURSOR_TOKEN.
